entry_points.text: Early NUMA option parsing, CPU node assign and clear, mask allocation with coverage validation, and late promotion of initiator and CPU nodes.
Boot-processor PAT setup, secondary PAT programming, and read-only debug list registration during late init.
Cache region invalidate reporting unsupported under hypervisor else system-wide writeback invalidate; per-page translation-cache flush helper.
Read-only-executable and globality toggles, machine-check isolation via non-canonical alias, present query, and user top-level allocation.

exports.text: Establish legacy or top-down mmap layout with randomized bases for native and compat tasks and provide accessor selecting base by legacy mode and address width.
Classify faulting instruction bytes as register read, register write, immediate write or unrelated, and report access width and source register or immediate value.
Bind processors to per-node sets and answer processor-to-node queries from early firmware storage before per-processor data is ready and from normal storage after.
Reserve and release IO ranges as write-combining, test immunity to uncached MTRR effects, set protections over page arrays, and force write-combining or writethrough modes.

hazards.text: Large-page diagnostic aborts; timestamps lag faults; missing early node tables are fatal; secondary without PAT aborts; reservation conflicts and sync failures error with cleanup.
Unmapped translation traps; unavailable invalidate warns and fails; early unmap with secondaries online warns; isolation depends on sanitized decoy address.

invariants.text: User hints must stay inside task range on one side of default boundary; physical extents must lie in direct map or pass validator; frame modification narrows only on leak-vulnerable hosts.
Prefix scan records operand-size, address-size and extension state; opcode decode accepts single byte and escaped two-byte forms.
Tracing offers filter offset, hard disable skipping probe registration, and toggle capturing program counter or zeroing it.
CPU-to-node falls back to no-node on bad IDs; node count is parsed-mask weight; emulation rewrites firmware table via translation array leaving sentinels.
PAT disable is idempotent and clears capability; translation maps six hardware values to cache modes with others folding to writeback plus text label.
Type lookup prefers untracked writeback then per-page RAM type then interval hit else uncached-minus; RAM reserve enforces first-page agreement while IO reserves, validates and syncs map.
Direct-map counters scale to kilobytes per level; initial protection derives from four permission bits with key, encryption and supported-mask adjustments.
New top directories clone kernel entries except when preallocated, join sync list with owner; preallocation is all-or-nothing; physical mask covers supported bits.
Self-test marks regions with reserved protection bit, walks direct map checking granularity and marker presence through mutate, verify, restore and re-verify.
Range, mask, lock, debugfs, print and page helpers used by this dossier are owned elsewhere; behavior follows those dossiers.

locks.text: Mutex serializes tracer start, stop and list changes; interrupt-safe spinlock guards event emission; atomic flag gates output; purge needs disabled stable state.
One spinlock serializes memtype interval queries; one private spinlock serializes attribute-change walks.
Global directory list tracks kernel page directories with owners; removal holds dedicated directory lock.

state_machines.text: At most one active fault per CPU; entry snapshots location, mapping ID, width and value; exit finalizes reads and emits; reentry or imbalance is fatal.
Enable arms probes, reduces to one CPU where supported, then marks active; disable clears active, drains remaps with no further callbacks, restores CPUs and tears down; idempotent.
NUMA bring-up resets mappings, builds blocks top-down, registers nodes, prunes offline-bound CPUs and spreads unassigned CPUs; source prefers ACPI then platform then device-tree then fake node.
Boot selects PAT table by capability and platform, builds cache modes high to low with log; secondary requires PAT when boot enabled it, programs saved value then flushes.
Uncached and combining reserve type before changing attributes and unwind on failure; writeback changes first then releases; arrays skip highmem and pass through intermediate step.
Direct-map helpers toggle present and writable without alias checks; middle-directory lookup fails on empty, non-present or leaf upper levels; translation combines frame by level with offset.

structs.text: Fault record pairs probe and instruction addresses with access class and nesting depth; remap entry links probe with physical base and ID; request, prefix, interval and tree-root layouts as cited.
APIC-to-node sized by max APIC IDs defaulting no-node; node masks sized by max nodes; page flags encode four types; PAT tables for disabled, errata and full cases; CPA option bits as cited.
Reason labels separate outside-region, unrelated, register read, register write, immediate write and unhandled; legacy prefix and opcode groups drive classification with 64-bit wide class.
